title: tcadarwin
description: https://www.tcadarwin.com.au is the official website of TCA Accountants & Bookkeepers, a firm based in Darwin, Northern Territory, Australia. The company is a reputable and innovative professional accounting, tax, and business growth advisory firm in the local area. The following is a detailed introduction to the company: Company Overview Year established: 2011. Founders: Co-founded and operated by George Giannikouris and Sarah Giannikouris. George has more than ten years of experience in the tax and accounting industry. Positioning: Committed to becoming the preferred financial and accounting services partner for local Northern Territory residents and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), with the core message of “helping clients work smarter and free up more time to do what they love.” Core features: Keeps pace with technological developments and excels at using digital tools (such as cloud-based systems and automation) to optimise businesses’ financial processes. Core Services TCA provides “one-stop” financial management and business improvement solutions, mainly including: Tax & Accounting: Individual and business income tax returns, company tax returns, and tax compliance and planning for sole traders, trusts, and partnerships. Bookkeeping Solutions: Cloud-based bookkeeping (mainly using Xero), payroll management, Single Touch Payroll (STP), day-to-day business account reconciliations, and remote bookkeeping services. Business Improvement & Automation: Assists SMEs in introducing digital systems, achieving paperless invoice scanning and process automation, and helping businesses reduce costs and improve operational efficiency. Data Analytics & Visualisation: Uses tools such as Microsoft Power BI to provide financial data dashboards for businesses, helping management make wiser strategic decisions.
